integrity: Symbolic proof contains a complete elementary derivation; finite computations are corroborative. No claim of peer review, independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative chain rings and commuting pairs of 2-by-2 matrices. The exact nonzero multipliers are given by Smith stratum, but their multiplicities are not tabulated. A broader historical association-scheme specialization may exist; the literature review is bounded.
title: Fourier support descent for commuting \(2\times2\) matrices over finite chain rings
